title: Recurring Care Add-Ons in an Assisted Living Advance Payment
content:
The recurring monthly care add-ons of an Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement advance payment — insulin management, oxygen management, diabetic monitoring and escort assistance — follow the care level in effect on the first day of each coming month:

1. **The care level the residency carries takes effect after the last day of the most recent billed month:** each insulin management, oxygen management, diabetic monitoring and escort assistance add-on billed for that month recurs at the fee of the care level carried, as published in the clinical and personal care fee schedules (a fee of 0.00 at that level recurs as 0.00).
2. **The level carried took effect on or before that day, none of those add-ons was billed for the most recent billed month, and some were billed for the month before it:** the add-ons of that earlier month resume at the amounts billed then.

Every other case falls outside this standard.

The most recent billed month is the billing month of the most recent full-month rent charge on the residency.

### Cases (hypothetical; most recent billed month August)

| Facts | Recurring add-ons per coming month |
|---|---|
| Level carried takes effect 3 September, moving to Assisted Living Care Level 5; August billed insulin management 465.00 and oxygen management 150.00 | Insulin and oxygen recur at the Level 5 fees, both 0.00 |
| Level carried takes effect 3 September, moving to Assisted Living Care Level 4; August billed insulin management 465.00 and escort assistance 295.00 | Insulin at 365.00 and escort assistance at 0.00, together 365.00 |
| Level effective in March; no recurring add-on billed for August; July billed diabetic monitoring 185.00 | 185.00 resumes |
| Level effective in March; August billed oxygen management 150.00 | Outside this standard |
